items.text: CURRENT [S1.0] export_records(records,user,params)->str; records keys id,title,owner,project,status,amount(str, keep exact),confidential,created,region,optional updated; do not modify input; ignore unknown params; default all records ascending id.
CURRENT [S1.3, S3.2] admin exports any project; others only records whose project in user projects, OR records they own (S3.2); silently drop others.
CURRENT [S1.4, S4.1] only status active; archived also included only if params include_archived is True AND role admin (S4.1).
CURRENT [S1.5, S5.1] confidential True never exported except role admin and purpose in (audit, litigation); other rules still apply.
CURRENT [S2.1] params since YYYY-MM-DD: only records with created on/after that date.
CURRENT [S2.2, S4.2] region ch (case-insensitive) exported only if ch in user regions (case-insensitive); applies to admins too.
CURRENT [S2.3] params max_records int>=1: only first N (ascending id) after all other rules.
CURRENT [S2.4, S3.1] Obligation now triggered (format changed to JSON): every export includes top-level field exported_by = user name.
CURRENT [S2.5, S4.3] title exported stripped of leading/trailing whitespace and internal whitespace runs collapsed to one space.
CURRENT [S2.6, S5.1] Obligation (now triggered by litigation): if confidential records exported for purpose other than audit, top-level confidential_count = number of confidential records in export.

CURRENT [S3.1, S2.5, S4.3] Output is json.dumps of object with key records: list (ascending id) of objects with exactly keys id (int), title (normalized), owner, amount (str exact). Replaces CSV of S1.1.
CURRENT [S3.2] Non-admin non-viewer users may also export records they own (owner == user name) even outside their projects.
CURRENT [S4.1] include_archived honoured only for role admin; other roles never get archived records.
CURRENT [S4.2] region values compared case-insensitively (records and user regions).
CURRENT [S4.3] titles: additionally collapse internal whitespace runs to single space.
CURRENT [S5.1] confidential also exported when role admin and purpose==litigation (triggers S2.6 confidential_count).
CURRENT [S5.2] viewers no longer error: export only records they own (owner==user name), any project; all other rules apply.
